problem_statement_fixed:
FCB-backed log walks must use bookmarks correctly: every expected entry is visited exactly once across the supplied skip, length, bookmark-count, and population cases.

A new syscfg setting LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS (restricted to LOG_FCB, default value 0) must be added to enable the bookmark optimization for FCB-backed log lookups.

The FCB header (fcb/fcb.h) must define a struct fcb_log_bmark and declare a function:
  void fcb_log_init_bmarks(struct fcb_log *fcb_log, struct fcb_log_bmark *buf, int bmark_count)
which configures the given fcb_log to use the supplied buffer of the given capacity for storing log-walk bookmarks.

When LOG_FCB_BOOKMARKS is enabled, FCB-backed log walks must use bookmarks to speed up lookups. The walk must visit every expected entry exactly once and no extra entries. FCB rotation must invalidate all bookmarks.
